Zaak 2026-0082 · het besluit en de openb: Case 2026-0082 · the decision and the public documents are in your case
2026-0082, verlichting fietspad Lindelaa: 2026-0082, lighting of the Lindelaan cycle path
Dit is een besluit van de gemeente. Het: This is a decision of the municipality. It applies from the day of publication.
Wij hebben een besluit genomen op uw Woo: We have made a decision on your Woo request about the lighting of the Lindelaan cycle path. Most of the documents you asked for will be made public. In two documents we redacted the names and phone numbers of employees.
Het besluit en de openbare documenten zi: The decision and the public documents were published today. You can read them in your case. Do you disagree with the decision? Then you can object until 18 November 2026.
Actie bij dit bericht, onderaan: Action for this message, at the bottom
